dedupe_keys.name: adia cmgr 500 m agricultural drought impacted area dataset for china s main grain region 2006 2020

description: ADIA-CMGR is a 500 m gridded dataset of agricultural drought impacts in China's main grain region for 2006 to 2020, giving drought-covered area, drought-damaged area and crop failure area across crop growing seasons. The Zenodo records say it was validated against text-based qualitative records of drought-impacted areas and reproduces their temporal variability and spatial pattern, and the later record points to generation code on GitHub. It was published on Zenodo in April 2025 and again in December 2025 by Sang Yanfang, Shi Jiali and co-authors (the later record lists affiliations including the University of California Irvine, KAUST and the University of Nottingham Ningbo China), under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as zip files of about 90 to 105 MB with a metadata document. Coverage is China's main grain-producing region. Caveats: the file formats inside the zips are not stated on the pages read, and the two records hold different zips (TARGET2 and TARGET3). For simulation it gives observed drought impact extents to calibrate crop loss and food supply disruption models. Related catalogue records include the DEDI global drought index and the Chinese provincial food demand data.
